data.title: Monsha'at Concludes 'Automotive Community' Event in Riyadh
data.content:
Riyadh, November 22, 2026, SPA -- The Small and Medium Enterprises General Authority (Monsha'at) yesterday concluded the "Automotive Community" event in Riyadh, in partnership with the Saudi Standards, Metrology and Quality Organization, as part of the "Business Support Communities" initiative.
    The event aimed to connect entrepreneurs and small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) with supporting entities and enhance growth opportunities in the automotive sector.
    It brought together the Zakat, Tax and Customs Authority, the Saudi Automobile and Motorcycle Federation, the Vehicle Safety Center, and several private-sector companies. It targeted entrepreneurs and SME owners operating in the automotive sector.
    The program featured panel discussions on automotive and spare parts market regulations, conformity and safety standards, and the role of local manufacturing in supply chains. Other sessions covered purchasing used vehicles, assessing their technical condition, financing options, and circular economy opportunities, including reusing vehicle components and recycling vehicles.
    The initiative aims to promote the exchange of knowledge and expertise among entrepreneurs and SME owners and help them benefit from the services and support available across sectors.
    -- SPA
